title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: 49ers D/ST forces five turnovers Sunday
items.desc: The 49ers defense allowed 17 points on 240 total yards with three interceptions and two fumble recoveries.
items.impact: It was a dominant afternoon for the 49ers defense with five turnovers forced. They'll face Dak Prescott and the Cowboys next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eddy Pineiro makes lone field goal Sunday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal attempt and all five extra point attempts.
items.impact: It was a busy day for Pineiro, but only one of his six attempts was a field goal.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Kittle totals 58 yards Sunday
items.desc: George Kittle caught 4-of-7 targets for 58 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Kittle led the Niners with seven targets. Brock Purdy attempted just 25 passes on the day. Kittle will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Cooks catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Brandin Cooks caught 2-of-2 targets for 25 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Cooks remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Watkins has big day Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Watkins caught 4-of-4 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Watkins was the player to take advantage of a depleted 49ers wide receiver room. He could hold WR3/flex appeal if Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel remain sidelined next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demarcus Robinson catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson caught 3-of-4 targets for 22 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Robinson was making his return from injured reserve. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaelon Black runs for 70 yards Sunday
items.desc: Kaelon Black ran for 70 yards on 11 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Black led San Francisco in rushing despite seeing seven fewer carries than Christian McCaffrey. He did not see a target in the passing game. He remains a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian McCaffrey totals two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for 19 yards receiving and another score.
items.impact: McCaffrey was able to dominate in another big role for the 49ers. He remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Purdy totals three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 17-of-25 passes for 232 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
items.impact: Purdy also added 40 yards and another score on the ground. Despite being without practically his entire wide receiver room, Purdy still found a way to make it work. He faces a very bad Cowboys defense next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Raiders D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Raiders defense allowed 31 points on 414 total yards with one interception and one sack.
items.impact: The Raiders defense remains off the fantasy radar, though they could be facing an injured Drew Lock or potentially Jalen Milroe in his first career start next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Gay connects on three kicks Sunday
items.desc: Matt Gay made his lone field goal attempt and both extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Gay made his lone field goal from 50 yards out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Mayer hauls in three passes Sunday
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mayer nearly found the end zone, but he lost a fumble at the goal line. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers continues to dominate Sunday
items.desc: Brock Bowers caught 7-of-8 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Bowers remains the most consistent part of the Raiders offense on a week-to-week basis. He did lose a fumble on the day, but otherwise had another big day for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Nailor quiet Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught 2-of-4 targets for nine yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Nailor remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre Tucker totals 55 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught 4-of-8 targets for 55 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: The eight targets Tucker saw tied the team-high. He will remain a volatile WR3 heading into next week against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. struggles Sunday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. ran for -3 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: One week after taking over the workhorse role in the Raiders backfield, Washington and Ashton Jeanty both saw six carries on Sunday. He draws a tough Seahawks run defense next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty totals 11 touches Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty ran for 25 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers. He also caught 5-of-7 targets for -5 yards receiving.
items.impact: Jeanty led Las Vegas in rushing on the day with 25 yards. Mike Washington Jr. also saw six carries. Based on his role the past two games, Jeanty is solely a risky RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kirk Cousins throws three interceptions Sunday
items.desc: Kirk Cousins completed 22-of-32 passes for 216 yards with one touchdown and three interceptions in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
items.impact: Cousins nearly had a second touchdown pass before Michael Mayer fumbled the ball at the goal line. He was picked off three times and it had the potential to be worse. Cousins draws a tough Seahawks defense next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seahawks D/ST dominates Sunday
items.desc: The Seahawks defense allowed three points on 198 total yards with three sacks.
items.impact: The Seahawks were able to completely shut down the entire Cardinals offense all afternoon. They'll face Kirk Cousins and the Raiders on the road next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Myers connects on field goal Sunday
items.desc: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and two extra points against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Myers was able to bounce back following his struggles last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner totals two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: AJ Barner caught 2-of-4 targets for seven yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also added a rushing touchdown.
items.impact: Barner got the Seahawks on the board with a "BarnYard" at the goal line. He later had a controversial touchdown catch where it appeared the ball may have hit the ground, but the refs had the call on the field stand. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Tory Horton caught 2-of-3 targets for 22 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Horton has yet to repeat the same flashes he showed as a rookie last season. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp totals 32 yards Sunday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp caught 3-of-4 targets for 32 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Kupp had a couple of big receptions from Drew Lock in the middle of the field. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 'quiet' day Sunday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 7-of-10 targets for 51 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba was held to his worst performance of the season, but his seven receptions still helped fantasy managers in PPR leagues. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price totals 78 yards from scrimmage Sunday
items.desc: Jadarian Price ran for 24 yards on nine carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 54 yards receiving.
items.impact: Price led Seattle in receiving on the day, including an impressive 17-yard catch and run. Zach Charbonnet led the Seahawks on the ground on the day. Price should maintain flex value moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet runs for 77 yards Sunday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet ran for 77 yards on 16 carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards receiving.
items.impact: Charbonnet looked much better in his second game back from injury. He has also had another impressive run called back due to a penalty. He should remain on the flex radar moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cardinals D/ST holds steady Sunday
items.desc: The Cardinals D/ST allowed 17 points on 295 total yards.
items.impact: The Cardinals were able to hold Jaxon Smith-Njigba in check on the afternoon. That was about it for them. They'll remain off the fantasy radar next week against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chad Ryland knocks in field goal Sunday
items.desc: Chad Ryland made his lone field goal attempt against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Ryland knocked in a 28-yard field goal on the opening drive of the game. That was his lone scoring chance all afternoon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
items.desc: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: McBride nearly hauled in a touchdown late in the loss, but the pass was knocked away by Nick Emmanwori late in the fourth quarter. McBride remains a locked and loaded elite high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Wilson totals 60 yards Sunday
items.desc: Michael Wilson caught 6-of-7 targets for 60 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Wilson led Arizona in receiving on the day in a quiet game for the entire Cardinals offense. He'll remain a steady WR2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Allgeier sees 17 carries Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier ran for 46 yards on 17 carries in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for zero yards receiving.
items.impact: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gardner Minshew II struggles Sunday
items.desc: Gardner Minshew II completed 21-of-30 passes for 166 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: After coming in mid-game last week and leading Arizona to a comeback win against the Cowboys, Minshew struggled in a much tougher test this time around. He could see some more time as the starter, but it wouldn't be surprising if they give Carson Beck a chance before the end of the season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: New Orleans Saints D/ST racks up five sacks in win
items.desc: The New Orleans Saints D/ST racked up five sacks in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: While they didn't manage a takeaway, the Saints' five sacks helped their final fantasy total, rewarding those who started them. They will face division-rival Panthers next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Charlie Smyth racks up 11 kicking points in win
items.desc: Charlie Smyth hit three of four field goal attempts and both of his PATs in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Smyth racked up 11 kicking points in this game, putting up a great stat line in his first game as the Saints kicker. He will look to have another successful outing against the Panthers next time out.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Barion Brown makes splash play in win over Browns
items.desc: Barion Brown caught his only target for a big 52-yard gain in the Saints' 23-22 win against the Browns on Sunday. He also returned three kicks for 78 yards and five punts for 68 yards.
items.impact: Brown is making a name for himself on special teams, but is also having success as a deep threat as well. He's not startable in regular leagues, but for those who award return yards, he's been a nice addition.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Audric Estime leads Saints backfield in win
items.desc: Audric Estime ran 15 times for 72 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also caught his only target for five yards.
items.impact: Estime led the Saints' backfield in this one, racking up 16 touches to Kamara's nine. Estime could find some running room next week against Carolina as well, provided Travis Etienne doesn't return by then.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Juwan Johnson snags touchdown in win over Browns
items.desc: Juwan Johnson caught both of his targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Johnson had struggled to get much of anything going over the last few weeks, and Sunday was much the same aside from a touchdown that saved his fantasy day. He might have some better luck moving foward, but he's best left on the bench for now.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Devaughn Vele snags two passes in win
items.desc: Devaughn Vele caught two of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Vele was one of eight Saints players to catch a pass on Sunday, and he was tied for fourth in receptions. It's gonna be tough for Vele to find relevance with Jordyn Tyson now in the mix, so he can be dropped in most leagues.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Alvin Kamara runs for 32 yards in win
items.desc: Alvin Kamara ran six times for 32 yards and caught three of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Kamara was second among the Saints' running backs in carries, but first in targets. If Audric Estime is going to see an expanded role while Travis Etienne is still on the shelf, it's going to make life hard for Kamara, who is hanging on to fantasy relevance by a thread.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jordyn Tyson snags four passes in NFL debut
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson caught four of five targets for 30 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Tyson was second on the team in targets and receptions behind Chris Olave, great for an NFL debut and for coming off of an injury. He should only get better as he gets up to game speed and gets acclimated to the offense.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Olave sees 12 targets in win over Browns
items.desc: Chris Olave caught 7 of 12 targets for 98 yards in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Olave was hard at work in this one, more than doubling up the next closest Saint in targets, which was rookie Jordyn Tyson. He also nearly doubled up the next closest Saint in yardage and had three more receptions than any other. It was his best yardage total in a month, and he will look to keep things up against the Panthers next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyler Shough goes for 265 yards in win over Browns
items.desc: Tyler Shough completed 21-of-35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also ran 10 times for 51 yards.
items.impact: Shough had two fumbles in this game as well, but both were recovered by the offense. He didn't throw a pick, but he took five sacks. So it was a bit so-so in real life, but for fantasy, he did just fine and was boosted by his 51 rushing yards. He could be an interesting QB option next week against the Panthers.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cleveland Browns force two fumbles in loss
items.desc: The Cleveland Browns D/ST forced two fumbles against the Saints on Sunday, as well as racking up five sacks in the Browns' 23-22 loss.
items.impact: The Browns' defense made several great plays against the Saints, but to no avail in the end, as the Browns fell to 5-4. They are still a decent unit and can be streamed in the right matchup. That might not be the case next week, however, as they face the surging Texans.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Andre Szmyt goes for 10 kicking points in loss
items.desc: Andre Szmyt hit all three field goal attempts and his only PAT in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints.
items.impact: Szmyt did his part to keep the Browns in this game, going perfect 4-for-4 on kicking attempts of any kind on Sunday. He will look to stay strong next week against the surging Texans.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jerry Jeudy snags two passes in loss
items.desc: Jerry Jeudy caught two of four targets for 37 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Jeudy was able to reignite some of the 2025 chemistry he had with Shedeur Sanders, but he was still fourth on the team in yards and receptions. He's not startable in any format.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Dylan Sampson snags three passes in loss
items.desc: Dylan Sampson ran eight times for 21 yards and caught three of six targets for 27 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints.
items.impact: Sampson operated as the Browns' primary receiving back once again, something that he will do on the regular. His six targets tied for second on the team with KC Concepcion, which is great from a volume standpoint. He's a low-end flex at RB in PPR formats given his current role.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Denzel Boston goes for 98 yards in loss
items.desc: Denzel Boston caught six of seven targets for 98 yards in the Browns' 23-22 loss to the Saints in overtime on Sunday.
items.impact: Boston had been quiet for the last several weeks, but got going again against the Saints. He's yet to rack up a 100-yard game, but he now has three games where he's accumulated at least 89 yards. He's more of a flex play right now, but he has the upside to be a WR2 on a given week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. snags touchdown in loss to Saints
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a score in the Browns' 23-22 OT loss to the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Fannin was quiet for most of this game, but came through for fantasy managers with a 39-yard touchdown in overtime. For fantasy purposes, Fannin's on a hot streak and needs to be in lineups.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for long touchdown in loss
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday.
items.impact: Concepcion had a 64-yard score where he took a deep pass from Shedeur Sanders to the house. He did have a non-contact injury and hobbled off the field, but he came back in and caught his touchdown afterwards. Managers will need to monitor his status in practice this week to see if it pops up.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Quinshon Judkins struggles to get going against Saints defense
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins ran 15 times for 43 yards in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday. He also caught his only target for two yards.
items.impact: This was a prime spot for Judkins to go off, and he didn't. The Saints had been one of the best matchups for running backs this season, and Judkins failed to deliver. He's only been above 10 PPR points twice this season and is a low-end RB3 option at best until he shows signs of life.
